description: FastAPI route handlers for CRUD operations on 'Item' objects, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting items with permission checks.

methods.name: read_items
methods.description: Retrieves a list of items, with different queries for superusers and regular users.

methods.name: read_item
methods.description: Retrieves a specific item by ID, with permission checks.

methods.name: create_item
methods.description: Creates a new item with the current user as owner.

methods.name: update_item
methods.description: Updates an existing item if the user has permission.

methods.name: delete_item
methods.description: Deletes an item if the user has permission.
